data.narrative:
Chaos Industries, a Series D defense & security company founded by John Tenet, Bo Marr, Brett Cummings, and Gavin Hood, is currently valued at $4.5B post-money following $1B+ in cumulative fundraising. The valuation assessment draws from a comparable universe of two public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and eight private peers, with particular weight assigned to four same-stage, same-sector private comparables: Saronic ($9.2B), Quantum-Systems ($8.0B), True Anomaly ($2.2B), and Onebrief ($2.1B).

Two methods were applied to triangulate fair value. Stage-progression methodology, applying a standard 1.5x step-up multiplier from Series D to the next stage, yields $6.8B. Peer-median analysis across the four same-stage defense & security comparables produces $5.1B, with observed range spanning $2.1B to $9.2B. The wide peer dispersion reflects heterogeneity in business models and commercialization maturity within the frontier defense sector.

The triangulated valuation range spans $4.3B (low) to $7.8B (high), with a median implied value of $5.9B. The current $4.5B valuation sits at the lower bound of this range. Key uncertainties center on revenue trajectory and defense procurement momentum, as peer valuations within this sector exhibit material variance despite stage and sector alignment. Further diligence on revenue scale and customer concentration would narrow this range materially.
